items.title: Code duplication pehchanna aur main function (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of code duplication and the main function (PDF 54-55).

blocks.text: Code duplication (code ka dohraya jana) tab hota hai jab ek hi code kai jagah baar baar likha ho. Is se code sambhalna mushkil hota hai aur ghaltiyan (bugs) aati hain, kyunke ek tabdeeli har jagah karni parti hai. Dohraya hua code pehchan kar usay ek function ya module mein rakhna achhi modular programming ke liye zaroori hai.

Python mein main function batata hai ke program kahan se shuru ho. Isay aam taur par aise block mein bulaya jata hai jo check karta hai ke file seedhi chalayi gayi hai ya kisi aur file mein module ki tarah import hui hai.

Wazahat: file seedhi chalayi jaye (python main.py) to __name__ ki value "__main__" hoti hai, shart sach hoti hai aur main() chal kar "This is the main function." print karta hai. Agar yahi file kahin import ki jaye to main() khud nahi chalta. Kai modules wale bare projects mein yeh tareeqa mufeed hai.

blocks.prompt: File seedhi chalane par __name__ ki qeemat kya hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: "__main__"; file import hone par __name__ module ka apna naam hota hai.

items: Code duplication se bachein; dohraya code function/module mein rakhein.
if __name__ == "__main__": main() sirf seedha chalane par chalta hai.
